title: The Ratchet of Logic
summary: A 16-state example illustrates joint kernels and structural novelty. A counterexample to a Fredkin entangling-power conjecture appears among the 223,231 frozen theorems at The Omega Institute, an independent research institute. The November 21 joint statement certified Alpöge’s Lean proof of classical RH. Independent five-theorem audits also checked his Dirichlet GRH results. The film traces the Institute’s 8,490-shard replay, trureturing’s separate integer Hankel equivalence for classical RH and four questions still open.
summary_zh: 从 16 个状态的算例理解联合核与结构新颖性。独立研究机构 The Omega Institute 的 223,231 条冻结定理中，有一个反例推翻了关于 Fredkin 门纠缠能力的猜想。11 月 21 日的联合声明认证了 Alpöge 对经典黎曼猜想的 Lean 证明。独立审计核查的五条定理也包括他对狄利克雷广义黎曼猜想的结果。片中还介绍了研究院的 8,490 分片复现、trureturing 另证的经典黎曼猜想与整数 Hankel 判据的等价性，以及四个开放问题。
